title: There is / There are
summary: There is + singular noun. There are + plural noun. In questions, invert: Is there a bank near here? Are there any studen
rule: There is + singular noun. There are + plural noun. In questions, invert: Is there a bank near here? Are there any students?
examples: There is a park near my house.
tutorHints: Contrast there is vs have: There is a cat vs I have a cat.
